name: 22546 · Ruther Glen, VA
findings: ZIP 22546 (Ruther Glen) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22546 (Ruther Glen) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 22546 (Ruther Glen) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
